_opis: Povzetki video vodičev po buildih (razred/id builda). Napisani iz samodejnih angleških podnapisov YouTube, imena predmetov preverjena v katalogu. {{Ime}} postane predmet s tooltipom.

assassin/wake-of-fire.title: PD2 S13 Assassin Guide – Full Progression
assassin/wake-of-fire.author: philanthropy777
assassin/wake-of-fire.part: 26:29–36:27 · Endgame Wake of Fire (Hiimova povezava pri tem buildu)
assassin/wake-of-fire.skills: Max Wake of Fire in sinergiji Fire Blast ter Wake of Inferno. Po 1 točka v Blade Shield (proc in leech) in Burst of Speed (IAS breakpoint dosežeš že z orožjem). Max Shadow Master, vse ostalo v Dragon Flight: vsaka točka skrajša cooldown.
assassin/wake-of-fire.stats: Strength za opremo, Dexterity do maksimalnega blocka, ostalo Vitality.
assassin/wake-of-fire.gear: {{Ghostflame}} (50 % IAS za breakpoint, mana leech, fire skill damage; najboljša korupcija +1 skill z 2 socketoma), {{Gerke's Sanctuary}} (resi in PDR), circlet s +3 traps in 20 % FCR, {{Mara's Kaleidoscope}}, {{Magefist}} (korupcija 10 % block), {{Bul-Kathos' Wedding Band}} in {{Wisp Projector}} (korupcije PDR %), {{Chains of Honor}} ali {{Enigma}}. Charmi: small charmi s FHR, 3 trap skillerji, torch, Annihilus.
assassin/wake-of-fire.merc: {{Infinity}}, {{Flickering Flame}} (Resist Fire aura: resi in fire skill damage), {{Lava Gout}}, {{String of Ears}}, {{Marrowwalk}} (cannot be frozen), {{Heavenly Garb}}.
tips: Z Dragon Flight skačeš od skupine do skupine in sproti polagaš pasti; ne čakaš, da pošasti umrejo.
Zelo vzdržljiv: s korupcijami do 40 % PDR, zato primeren tudi za hardcore.
T3 Pandemonium Citadel izkušen igralec preteče v manj kot 4 minutah, ostali v okoli 4:30.
Fire Blast je v S13 dobil dve dodatni bombi, kar močno poveča škodo na posamezno tarčo (bossi).
vs_hiim: Enako: Fire Blast, Wake of Fire in Wake of Inferno na 20; Ghostflame, Gerke's Sanctuary, Mara's Kaleidoscope, Bul-Kathos' Wedding Band, circlet s +3 traps; merc z Infinity, Flickering Flame, Marrowwalk in String of Ears.

Razlika: Hiim maxa Shadow Warrior (ne Shadow Master) in da le 6 točk v Dragon Flight; oklep Guardian Angel namesto Chains of Honor ali Enigme; rokavice M'avina's Icy Clutch namesto Magefist; merc je Act 2 Defiance s Hustle in Dracul's Grasp.

assassin/wake-of-fire.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Assassin Changes and Testing results
assassin/wake-of-fire.author: JuxtAPoser
tips: Za zgodnje budget mapanje je lightning trapsin (Chain Lightning Sentry) boljši od Wake of Fire.
Wake of Fire postane res dober šele z Infinity na mercu, zato ima višjo vstopno ceno. Do takrat igraj lightning pasti in zbiraj charme.

assassin/chain-lightning-sentry.title: PD2 S14 Assassin Guide – Full Progression
assassin/chain-lightning-sentry.author: philanthropy777
assassin/chain-lightning-sentry.part: 0:00–8:59 · Day 1 Chain Lightning Trap (video pri Hiimovem Day 1 planerju)
assassin/chain-lightning-sentry.skills: 1 točka v Dragon Flight za mobilnost. Max Chain Lightning Sentry (glavni za Arcane), nato Lightning Sentry (posamezne tarče), nato Fire Blast (sinergija in škoda na lightning imune elite). Po 1 točka v Shadow Master in Burst of Speed, ostalo v Charged Bolt Sentry.
assassin/chain-lightning-sentry.stats: Strength za opremo, Dexterity po potrebi, ostalo Vitality.
assassin/chain-lightning-sentry.gear: Day 1: {{Spirit}}, {{Splendor}} (če dobiš Lum) ali {{Ancients' Pledge}} v drugi roki, {{Lore}} helm, {{Stealth}} ali oklep s +3 traps, claw-i s +3 traps iz trgovine, amulet in circlet s +3 traps. Rese na rokavicah, pasu in škornjih, na prstanih half freeze ali cannot be frozen.
tips: Takoj po Hell kampanji farmaj Arcane Sanctuary: Summoner za Hate ključe, charmi, nizke rune in gemi za crafte. Ko ubiješ Summonerja, začni novo igro.
IAS na opremi pospeši polaganje pasti; zgodaj to ni pomembno.
Cilj začetka je Natalya's set, s katerim prestopiš v T1 in T2 mape (Blades of Ice).
Uporabljaj sledilnik corrupted zon in izberi tiste brez lightning imunih; dropajo tudi Worldstone Sharde.
vs_hiim: Enako: Chain Lightning Sentry, Lightning Sentry, Charged Bolt Sentry in Fire Blast na 20 (v planerju za level 80); Act 1 Vigor merc; Lore, Stealth ali Smoke; amulet in diadem s +3 traps (Cunning); dva claw-a s +traps.
Razlika: video da po 1 točko v Dragon Flight in Shadow Master, Hiimova planerja ne; Hiim mercu da Purity ali Witherstring.

assassin/chain-lightning-sentry.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Assassin Changes and Testing results
assassin/chain-lightning-sentry.author: JuxtAPoser
assassin/chain-lightning-sentry.part: 0:00–6:30 leveling in Ubers · 15:01–18:30 budget mape · 23:41–24:50 trap delay
tips: Leveling: v Normalu Blade Sentinel ali takoj Fire Blast do 20, od levela 24 Lightning Sentry. Pri levelu 75 pri Anyi v Nightmare kupi claw-e s +2 Lightning Sentry ali Chain Lightning Sentry.
Merc: Insight za mano, Purity za regen lifea ali Stormspire za škodo.
Ubers: Lightning Sentry na levelu 29 je dovolj, 33–35 je udobno. Na swap daj wand z Lower Resist, uporabi Fade; rese 150 cold, 125 lightning, 75 fire.
V mapah build zaživi okoli levela 45–47 Chain Lightning Sentry. Lightning large charmi so na začetku sezone poceni namesto skillerjev.
S14 trap delay (AI delay Lightning Sentry 15 → 13, Chain Lightning Sentry 15 → 14) po njegovih podatkih verjetno vpliva le na prvi strel pasti, zato je buff majhen.

sorceress/charged-bolt.title: Pd2 S12 Closed Beta Mini Guide/Showcase – Charged Bolt
sorceress/charged-bolt.author: JuxtAPoser
sorceress/charged-bolt.part: cel video (11 min). Novejšega vodiča za Charged Bolt nisem našel; v S14 se skill ni spremenil.
sorceress/charged-bolt.skills: Max Charged Bolt, njegovi sinergiji Telekinesis in Lightning ter Lightning Mastery (80 točk). Preostalih ~25 točk: max Teleport (več škode) ali max Energy Shield (varnost). Po 1 točka v Warmth in Shiver Armor.
sorceress/charged-bolt.stats: Strength za opremo (okoli 77), ostalo Vitality. Z Energy Shieldom vse v Energy.
sorceress/charged-bolt.gear: Sam nosiš {{Infinity}} na bazi s +3 Charged Bolt (bonus še +Lightning Mastery, Teleport ali Energy Shield), {{Griffon's Eye}} ali {{Kira's Guardian}} z lightning faceti, {{Ormus' Robes}} (dodatni Charged Bolt, FCR) s faceti, {{Arachnid Mesh}} ali {{Thundergod's Vigor}}, rokavice s 30 % FCR (z Energy Shieldom {{Occultist}}), {{Silkweave}}, amulet +2 sorc z 10 % FCR ali blood amulet. Swap: Call to Arms. Charmi: skillerji, torch, Annihilus, all res small charmi.
sorceress/charged-bolt.merc: Tank z {{Stormspire}}, {{Innocence}}, {{Ferocity}}, {{String of Ears}} in {{Dracul's Grasp}}.
tips: Cilji: FCR breakpoint 200 %, 8–12 life po kill, 7–8 mane po kill.
Najprej pošlji Charged Bolte v sobo, šele nato teleportiraj noter. Ne pusti se obkoliti in pazi, da merc ostane živ.
Zelo močen na bossih. Avtor ga ima za malo šibkejšega od najboljših cold in fire buildov, a je bil med lightning buildi najhitrejši v T2 in T3.
vs_hiim: Enako: Charged Bolt, Lightning, Telekinesis, Lightning Mastery in Teleport na 20; Infinity (cb), Griffon's Eye, Ormus' Robes, Thundergod's Vigor, Silkweave.
Razlika: Hiim ima Occultist in 8 točk v Energy Shield, dva Stone of Jordan in magic amulet z +lightning skilli in FCR. Hiimov planer nima merca.

sorceress/charged-bolt.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Sorc Changes and Testing results
sorceress/charged-bolt.author: JuxtAPoser
tips: Za Charged Bolt v S14 ni sprememb. Sorc dobi +1 mano na level in 1,25 lifea na level namesto 1.
Za budget lightning začetek je testiral Chain Lightning s Skyfallom, ki ne potrebuje Infinityja.

necromancer/elemental-summoner-mage-skel.title: PD2 S13 Necro Guide – Full Progression
necromancer/elemental-summoner-mage-skel.author: philanthropy777
necromancer/elemental-summoner-mage-skel.part: 33:38–46:31 · Endgame Skeleton Mages (Hiimova povezava pri tem buildu)
necromancer/elemental-summoner-mage-skel.skills: 1 Bone Armor, po želji 1 Desecrate (za Uber Tristram). Max Skeleton Mastery, Raise Skeletal Mage in Raise Skeleton Archer, nato max Golem Mastery. Blood Warp do cooldowna 0,4 s, ostalo v Lower Resist. Po želji 1 Revive.
necromancer/elemental-summoner-mage-skel.stats: Okoli 210 Strength za {{Steel Carapace}}, 0 Vitality, ostalo Energy (Bone Armor dobi +3 absorb na točko Energy).
necromancer/elemental-summoner-mage-skel.gear: {{Grim's Burning Dead}} (brez CTA na swapu, ker ob zamenjavi izgubiš 6 magov), {{Harlequin Crest}} z MF in all res jeweli, {{Steel Carapace}}, {{Gravepalm}} (+1 summoning), {{Wisp Projector}} in {{Bul-Kathos' Wedding Band}}, {{Marrowwalk}} ali {{War Traveler}}, {{Mara's Kaleidoscope}} ali rare amulet z ~25 all res. Charmi: Gheed's, summoning skillerji z lifeom, MF small charmi.
necromancer/elemental-summoner-mage-skel.merc: Lightning merc (Holy Shock aura, casta Static Field in Chain Lightning) z {{Griffon's Eye}}; z {{Beast}} (Fanaticism) magi napadajo hitreje. Iron Golem je narejen iz {{Infinity}} (Conviction).
tips: MF build: z MF korupcijami do okoli 575 % MF, lahko igraš tudi fortified mape.
Skeletal Mage strelja kot napad, zato ga Fanaticism (Beast) pospeši: okoli 14 % več škode. Beast na levelu 8 je dovolj za drugi najboljši breakpoint.
Zelo varen in »lene« igre: z Blood Warp skačeš naprej, peti pobijajo sami.
vs_hiim: Enako: Raise Skeletal Mage in Skeleton Mastery na 20, Lower Resist za imune; Grim's Burning Dead, Gravepalm, Marrowwalk, Wisp Projector; Infinity v buildu.

Razlika: Hiim S14 maxa Revive (elementalni revivi) in Lower Resist, Curse Mastery na 10, namesto Archerjev in Golem Mastery. Hiim nosi Harlequin Crest, Enigmo, Arachnid Mesh, blood craft amulet in SoJ; merc je Act 2 Defiance z Infinity, Flickering Flame, Shaftstop, Bloodfist in Siggard's Staunch.

necromancer/elemental-summoner-mage-skel.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Necro Changes and Testing results
necromancer/elemental-summoner-mage-skel.author: JuxtAPoser
tips: Magi v S14 niso dobili velikih sprememb, Lower Resist pa ima 9 % več piercea, kar pomaga pri zgodnjem mapanju.
Poceni build za prehod v mape, ko imaš nekaj valute. Pozno v beti so okrepili še Skeleton Archerje (ni testiral).

druid/cold-elemental-arctic-blast-hurric.title: Pd2 S12 Closed Beta Mini Guide/Showcase – Arctic Blast
druid/cold-elemental-arctic-blast-hurric.author: JuxtAPoser
druid/cold-elemental-arctic-blast-hurric.part: cel video (11 min). Hiim ima pri tem buildu le posnetek mape brez govora.
druid/cold-elemental-arctic-blast-hurric.skills: Max Arctic Blast in vse tri sinergije (Hurricane, Tornado, Cyclone Armor): 80 točk. 1 točka v Twister kot predpogoj. Gust do levela 29 brez Battle Orders (30 z njimi). Ostalo v Oak Sage ali po želji Summon Grizzly in trte.
druid/cold-elemental-arctic-blast-hurric.stats: Okoli 165 Strength in 109 Dexterity za opremo, ostalo Vitality.
druid/cold-elemental-arctic-blast-hurric.gear: Budget: {{Frostwind}} (Resist Cold aura, +Arctic Blast), {{Nightwing's Veil}}, {{Skin of the Vipermagi}}, {{Medusa's Gaze}}, {{Mara's Kaleidoscope}} ali brilliant ali blood craft amulet, {{Dracul's Grasp}} (life po kill) ali FCR rokavice, {{Silkweave}} ali MF ali res škornji, prstani za rese. Še ceneje: {{Spirit}} namesto Medusa's Gaze. Endgame: Frostwind s 4 cold faceti, Nightwing's Veil s faceti, {{Ormus' Robes}} s cold škodo. Swap: Call to Arms.
druid/cold-elemental-arctic-blast-hurric.merc: {{Infinity}}: po avtorju edini res drag kos in obvezen za ta build.
tips: Arctic Blast je channel: med streljanjem stojiš na mestu. Hurricane prižgi, z Gustom se premikaj, nato drži Arctic Blast.
FCR 68 % je v redu, 99 % je boljše (FCR na rokavicah, prstanih ali amuletu).
Budget T1 mapa okoli 6 minut, T3 z dobro opremo 6–7 minut. Zelo varen, primeren za hardcore.
vs_hiim: Enako: Arctic Blast, Hurricane, Tornado in Cyclone Armor na 20, Oak Sage ostanek; Frostwind, Medusa's Gaze, Nightwing's Veil, Dracul's Grasp, Call to Arms na swapu; Strength okoli 160.

Razlika: Hiim nosi Steel Carapace, Siggard's Staunch, Imp Shank, Chaos talisman, Constricting Ring in SoJ; merc je Act 3 Iron Wolf (Static Field) s Skyfall, Exile, Innocence, Flickering Flame, Occultist in Marrowwalk namesto Infinity.

druid/cold-elemental-arctic-blast-hurric.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Druid Changes and Testing results
druid/cold-elemental-arctic-blast-hurric.author: JuxtAPoser
tips: V S14 je najbolj okrepljen Twister (wind druid s Twisterjem je pri Hiimu ločen build). Tornado in Hurricane sta okrepljena manj, avtor razlike ni opazil.
Vsak cast Twisterja (in Tornada) skrajša cooldown Gusta, zato se zelo hitro premikaš.
Za budget wind druida sta ključna nakupa Horizon's Tornado in Skin of the Vipermagi; merc z Amplify Damage (The Reaper's Toll) okrepi fizično škodo.

druid/cold-elemental-arctic-blast-hurric.title: A Forgotten Skill That Actually Works in PD2 | Arctic Blast Druid
druid/cold-elemental-arctic-blast-hurric.author: looter
druid/cold-elemental-arctic-blast-hurric.part: cel video (30 min) · leveling od 1 do Hell Baala
tips: Arctic Blast ima v PD2 tri sinergije in z levelom znižuje cold res, zato je že pri levelingu močan.
Za cold imune in cold enchanted pošasti uporabi Tornado (fizična škoda).
Med channelingom te udarci prekinejo, zato rabiš tanka spredaj: Act 2 Defiance merc ali Summon Grizzly. Cyclone Armor dobi dodatni absorb na točko Energy.

amazon/strafe-demon-machine.title: PD2 S14 Amazon Guide – Full Progression
amazon/strafe-demon-machine.author: philanthropy777
amazon/strafe-demon-machine.part: 4:49–23:06 · Day 2–5 in Endgame Strafe (video pri Hiimovem planerju)
amazon/strafe-demon-machine.skills: Day 2–5: max Strafe in sinergija Penetrate, max Pierce in Critical Strike, 1 točka v Dodge. Endgame (level 99): max Strafe, Penetrate, Critical Strike, Javelin and Spear Mastery in Evade; Pierce dobiš s korupcijo na pasu, ostalo v Dodge.
amazon/strafe-demon-machine.stats: Strength in Dexterity za opremo; za mape okoli 10.000 attack ratinga, ostalo Vitality. Endgame skoraj vse v Dexterity (okoli 1.000 lifea).
amazon/strafe-demon-machine.gear: {{Demon Machine}} (nadgradnja v elite z Lum + Pul + Perfect Emerald, ED jeweli; endgame 5 socketov), {{Valkyrie Wing}} (+2 amazon skilla, FRW), {{Atma's Scarab}} ali blood craft amulet, {{Shatterhead}} (−4 % enemy physical res; v S14 crushing blow deluje tudi na puščice), {{Lionheart}} ali {{Hustle}}, {{Laying of Hands}}, {{Carrion Wind}} in {{Raven Frost}}, {{Razortail}} (pierce, max dmg, dex), {{War Traveler}}. Endgame: {{Soul Drainer}} z DS korupcijo, {{Wisp Projector}} s FRW, {{Gore Rider}}, swap {{Call to Arms}} in {{Lidless Wall}}. Nov runeword {{Deception}} da velik crit množitelj, a v helm slotu izgubiš veliko resov.
amazon/strafe-demon-machine.merc: Day 2–5: Act 1 Vigor s {{Purity}} (Prayer aura: life na zadetek). Endgame: Act 1 Vigor s {{Faith}} (Fanaticism vsaj level 14 za IAS breakpoint), {{Vampire Gaze}}, {{Templar's Might}} (Might aura), {{Lava Gout}}, {{Bannerlord's Call}}.
tips: Build je na najhitrejšem IAS breakpointu; s Purity mercom se life ves čas polni, umreš lahko le zaradi one-shota.
Day 2–3 že čisti T1 in T2 mape. Najprej kupi Razortail in War Traveler; Demon Machine stane nekaj Worldstone Shardov.
Endgame: T3 ear mape v okoli 7–7,5 minute. Za posamezne bosse je Guided Arrow morda boljši od Strafa.
Javelin and Spear Mastery v PD2 doda crit multiplier tudi puščicam.
vs_hiim: Enako (day 2–5): Demon Machine, Shatterhead, Valkyrie Wing, Lionheart, Laying of Hands, Razortail, War Traveler, Atma's Scarab, Carrion Wind, Raven Frost; Strafe, Penetrate, Pierce in Critical Strike na 20; Act 1 Vigor s Purity.
Enako (endgame): Soul Drainer, Razortail, Carrion Wind, Wisp Projector, Gore Rider, CTA in Lidless; merc s Faith, Vampire Gaze, Templar's Might, Lava Gout in Bannerlord's Call.
Razlika: Hiim endgame maxa Valkyrie namesto Javelin and Spear Mastery in nosi Abyssal Ward, Veil of Steel, Tyrael's Might in Seraph's Hymn.

amazon/multiple-shot.title: PD2 S14 Amazon Guide – Full Progression
amazon/multiple-shot.author: philanthropy777
amazon/multiple-shot.skills: Max Multiple Shot, Critical Strike in Penetrate; 1 točka v Guided Arrow za posamezne tarče; Pierce le do 100 % (4–7 točk), nato max Valkyrie (tank) in ostalo v Evade. Endgame s pierce korupcijo na Razortail le 2 točki v Pierce, ostalo v Dodge.
amazon/multiple-shot.stats: Strength za opremo (Windforce zahteva 134), okoli 200 Vitality (700–800 lifea je s Prayer mercom dovolj), ostalo Dexterity.
amazon/multiple-shot.gear: Day 2–5 (zelo poceni): {{Cliffkiller}} (IAS, 30 % pierce, knockback), {{Deception}}, {{Hustle}}, {{Atma's Scarab}} ali {{The Eye of Etlich}}, {{Swiftwind Needle}}, {{Goblin Toe}}, {{Manald Heal}}, {{Raven Frost}}, {{Razortail}}. Endgame: {{Windforce}} (4 socketi z ED/IAS slamom so v njegovih izračunih celo boljši od 6 socketov in od mirror Grand Matron Bowa), {{Doom's Finger}}, {{Veil of Steel}}, {{Highlord's Wrath}}, {{Soul Drainer}}, {{Wisp Projector}}, {{Bul-Kathos' Wedding Band}}, {{War Traveler}}; swap {{Call to Arms}} in {{Lidless Wall}}.
amazon/multiple-shot.merc: Day 2–5: merc s Prayer auro, {{Spirit}} meč in {{Spirit}} ščit (cilj 63–86 % FCR). Endgame: Act 1 Vigor s {{Faith}}, {{Vampire Gaze}}, {{Templar's Might}}, {{Arachnid Mesh}}, {{Lava Gout}}, {{Marrowwalk}}, {{Bannerlord's Call}}.
tips: Valkyrie je tvoj tank: stoj za njo in jo znova pokliči, ko pade ali ima pol lifea.
Vrstni red nakupov: najprej Windforce (nato Manald Heal zamenjaj za prstan z min dmg, AR in resi), potem Doom's Finger, potem torch.
Crit multiplier je večji od deadly strika, zato avtor ne jemlje DS korupcij.
T3 ear mape gladko, Kyovoshad v okoli 5 minutah. Po avtorju bo Multishot eden najboljših buildov S14.
vs_hiim: Enako: day 2–5 Cliffkiller, Swiftwind Needle, Deception, Hustle, Goblin Toe, Manald Heal, Raven Frost, Razortail, The Eye of Etlich, merc s Prayer in dvema Spiritoma; endgame Windforce, Doom's Finger, Veil of Steel, Highlord's Wrath, Soul Drainer, Wisp Projector, BK, Razortail, War Traveler, CTA in Lidless; merc Faith, Vampire Gaze, Templar's Might, Arachnid Mesh, Lava Gout, Marrowwalk, Bannerlord's Call.
Razlika: Hiim endgame nosi Tyrael's Might in ima 17 točk v Pierce.

amazon/multiple-shot.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Amazon Changes and Testing results
amazon/multiple-shot.author: JuxtAPoser
tips: Multishot: začetni ED s 30 na 50 %, +2 % ED na level (pri levelu 26–30 okoli 70–90 % več ED), 5 puščic namesto 3, največ 29 namesto 24.
Vse Multishot puščice zdaj sprožijo knockback, blind, freeze, crushing blow, slow in open wounds (velja tudi za Split Throw).
Nov budget začetek je Multishot bleed: lok z veliko bleeda (npr. Gut Siphon) in Purity merc; bleed pri pierce ne izgubi škode.

amazon/lightning-fury.title: PD2 S13 Amazon Guide – Full Progression
amazon/lightning-fury.author: philanthropy777
amazon/lightning-fury.skills: Max Lightning Fury (čiščenje) in njegove sinergije, med njimi Lightning Bolt (posamezne tarče); max Power Strike; Pierce do 100 %, ostalo pol v Evade in pol v Dodge.
amazon/lightning-fury.stats: Strength in Dexterity za opremo, ostalo Vitality (okoli 2.400 lifea).
amazon/lightning-fury.gear: Javelin s čim več socketi (5–6) in korupcijo pierce, IAS ali FCR; {{Griffon's Eye}}; {{Enigma}} (amazonkin teleport je počasen, zato rabiš FCR, v videu 85 %); {{Lidless Wall}} namesto {{Spirit Ward}} zaradi FCR in mane po kill; rokavice z IAS, half freeze in pierce korupcijo; škornji s trojnimi resi in FRW; pas s pierce; {{Bul-Kathos' Wedding Band}}; amulet s +2 in korupcijo (FRW, IAS, pierce) je po avtorju boljši od Highlord's. vs_hiim: Enako: Lightning Fury, Lightning Bolt, Pierce in Power Strike na 20; Griffon's Eye, Enigma, Lidless Wall, BK; merc z Infinity, Dracul's Grasp, Marrowwalk in String of Ears.
Razlika: Hiim nosi Thunderstroke, Lancer's rokavice, Arachnid Mesh in blood craft amulet, na swapu Zerae's Resolve; merc je Act 2 Defiance s Ferocity in Innocence.

amazon/lightning-fury.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Amazon Changes and Testing results
amazon/lightning-fury.author: JuxtAPoser
amazon/lightning-fury.part: 0:41–2:30 javelin drevo · 7:01–8:00 nove možnosti za javeline
tips: Lightning Fury v S14 ni spremenjen in ostaja S tier mapper.

amazon/fire-arrow.title: PD2 S13 Amazon Guide – Full Progression
amazon/fire-arrow.author: philanthropy777
amazon/fire-arrow.skills: Max Fire Arrow, Magic Arrow (sinergija) in Immolation Arrow; Pierce do 100 %, max Evade, ostalo v Penetrate (AR, prihrani Dexterity).
amazon/fire-arrow.stats: Strength in Dexterity za opremo, ostalo Vitality (okoli 1.700 lifea).
amazon/fire-arrow.gear: {{Blood Raven's Charge}} s 5 fire faceti, {{Kira's Guardian}} s 3 faceti (half freeze, resi, pierce), {{Hustle}} (Burst of Speed za hitrost; {{Enigma}} gre, a teleport je počasen), blood craft amulet (+2 amazon, FRW, FCR, life, resi), puščice z 2 socketoma, rokavice s pierce korupcijo, {{Wisp Projector}} in {{Bul-Kathos' Wedding Band}}, {{Razortail}}. assassin/blades-of-ice.title: PD2 S14 Assassin Guide – Full Progression
assassin/blades-of-ice.author: philanthropy777
assassin/blades-of-ice.part: 8:59–31:00 · Day 2–5 in Endgame Blades of Ice z Natalya's setom (video pri Hiimovem planerju)
assassin/blades-of-ice.skills: Max Blades of Ice in Tiger Strike (sinergija); max Shadow Warrior (ne Master: Warriorji ponavljajo tvoj skill, zato daj Blades of Ice na levi klik). Po 1 točka v Dragon Flight in Blade Shield (striking skill, sproži leech). Burst of Speed do max IAS frame-a, nato Weapon Block (endgame 37, z BO 38 za breakpoint), ostalo v Burst of Speed. Claw and Dagger Mastery za AR po želji.
assassin/blades-of-ice.stats: Strength in Dexterity za opremo, ostalo Vitality; za mape okoli 10.000 attack ratinga.
assassin/blades-of-ice.gear: Natalya's set: {{Natalya's Mark}}, {{Natalya's Totem}}, {{Natalya's Shadow}}, {{Natalya's Soul}} (20 % PDR, leech, +1 senca), {{Whispering Mirage}} (dodatna senca), amulet s +3 martial arts ali blood craft, rokavice z 20 % IAS in +2 martial arts, {{Raven Frost}} (CBF, AR). Endgame: vsi kosi s 3 socketi in cold faceti, +1 korupcija na oklepu, {{Snowclash}} (+2 cold, half freeze), {{Bul-Kathos' Wedding Band}} in {{Wisp Projector}} (AR iz Heart of Wolverine), rokavice s half freeze korupcijo za CBF, FHR skillerji, swap {{Call to Arms}} in {{Lidless Wall}}.
assassin/blades-of-ice.merc: Day 2–5: Act 1 Vigor s {{Purity}}. Endgame: Act 2 Defiance z {{Infinity}}, {{Vampire Gaze}}, {{Templar's Might}}, {{String of Ears}}, {{Lava Gout}}, {{Marrowwalk}}.
tips: Weapon Block je po avtorju eden najmočnejših obrambnih skillov v PD2, ko nosiš dva claw-a.
Vrstni red nadgradenj: assassin torch, skillerji, Natalya's Shadow s 3 socketi in cold faceti, Infinity za merca, šele nato Annihilus.
Skill daj na tipko za quick cast in jo drži; z Dragon Flight skači od skupine do skupine.
Blades of Ice in Fist of Fire sta po avtorju najboljša martial arts skilla; T3 ear mape gredo.
vs_hiim: Enako: Blades of Ice, Tiger Strike in Shadow Warrior na 20; Natalya's set, Whispering Mirage, Raven Frost (day 2–5), Snowclash, BK, Wisp Projector, blood craft amulet, CTA in Lidless; merc s Purity (day 2–5) ter endgame Infinity, Vampire Gaze, Templar's Might, Lava Gout, Marrowwalk in String of Ears.
Razlika: Hiim endgame ima Weapon Block 18, Burst of Speed 11 in Claw and Dagger Mastery 10; rokavice Kenshi's Gloves of Quickness.

assassin/blade-sentinel-venom.title: Project Diablo 2 S12 – Venom Blade Sentinel Assassin – Easiest T2 Boss Build I've Played!
assassin/blade-sentinel-venom.author: Sleepy Cat
assassin/blade-sentinel-venom.part: 1:55–11:00 · Venom Blade Sentinel (S14 video za ta build nima podnapisov)
assassin/blade-sentinel-venom.skills: Le 1 točka v Blade Sentinel. Max Venom in Cobra Strike (sinergija), max Shadow Warrior; ostalo v Burst of Speed (hitrost) in Weapon Block ali Claw and Dagger Mastery (za mapanje).
assassin/blade-sentinel-venom.gear: Natalya's set: {{Natalya's Mark}} s 3 socketi in poison faceti, {{Natalya's Totem}}, {{Natalya's Shadow}}, {{Natalya's Soul}} (20 % PDR, resi, +1 senca). {{Venom Grip}} (max poison res, za Rathmo) ali {{Lava Gout}} (DClone), {{Nature's Peace}} (max resi) ali {{Bul-Kathos' Wedding Band}}, {{Verdungo's Hearty Cord}} (block), amulet +2 assassin z max resi, v drugi roki {{Plague}} na claw-u s +3 Venom (−20 % enemy poison res, Cleansing aura) ali {{Whispering Mirage}} za mapanje. Shadow discipline skillerji, torch, Annihilus.
tips: Bistvo: sence mečejo Blade Sentinele; vsak sentinel je minion in nanese svoj Venom strup, strupi iz različnih virov pa se seštevajo.
Blade Sentinel daj na levi in desni klik, da ga sence uporabljajo ves čas; ti preživljaš in vzdržuješ buffe.
Odličen bosser (T2 DClone, Lucion, Ubers) s poceni opremo; mapanje gre, a počasi (Whispering Mirage in Dragon Flight).
V S12 so imeli T2 bossi zaradi hrošča manj lifea. S14 patch notes popravljajo prepisovanje strupov iz različnih virov.
vs_hiim: Enako: Venom in Cobra Strike na 20; Natalya's set, Whispering Mirage, Venom Grip, Verdungo's Hearty Cord, Nature's Peace.

Razlika: Hiim maxa Blade Sentinel in Claw and Dagger Mastery (sentinele meče sam), Shadow Warrior ima le 2 točki; nosi Mara's Kaleidoscope in Raven Frost, merc je Act 3 Iron Wolf s Skyfall, Exile in Innocence.

barbarian/warcry.title: PD2 S13 Barb Guide – Full Progression
barbarian/warcry.author: philanthropy777
barbarian/warcry.part: 1:22:29–konec · Endgame War Cry (Hiimova povezava) · 0:00–6:45 Day 1 War Cry
barbarian/warcry.skills: Max War Cry, Howl in Battle Cry (sinergije, 17 % na level), Battle Command, ostalo Battle Orders; po 1 točka v Combat Reflexes, Iron Skin in Natural Resistance. Day 1 še 1 točka v Find Item za Travincal.
barbarian/warcry.stats: Malo Strength, vse ostalo Vitality (endgame več kot 4.000 lifea).
barbarian/warcry.gear: Day 1: dva {{Spirit}} (FCR breakpoint 105), {{Lore}}, {{Stealth}}, amulet z +2 War Cry, caster craft rokavice, brilliant prstan in škornji (half freeze, CBF). Endgame: orožje s FCR, +1 skillom in teleport naboji, {{Enigma}}, crafted helm s +War Cry in FCR ali {{Wildspeaker}}, amulet +3 War Cry z 10 % FCR, {{Soul Drainer}} s FCR (−phys res; War Cry je fizična škoda), dva {{Constricting Ring}}, pas z 20 % FCR ali {{Arachnid Mesh}}, {{Silkweave}} ali {{Marrowwalk}}. Cilj 200 % FCR in 86 % FHR (48 je dovolj).
barbarian/warcry.merc: Day 1: tank s safety craft helmom in oklepom ter blood crafti. Endgame: Act 3 (Static Field ob vsakem teleportu) s {{Skyfall}}, {{Innocence}} (decrepify), {{Occultist}} in {{Marrowwalk}}.
tips: Day 1 farmaj Travincal in corrupted zone; za prehod na Whirlwind rabiš okoli 40–50 Worldstone Shardov.
War Cry je v S13 dobil 15 % večji radij. Igra: tele-stomp z Enigmo, ko zmanjka nabojev, uporabiš orožje s teleportom.
Šibkost je single target: najprej Battle Cry (−phys res), nato War Cry.
vs_hiim: Enako: War Cry, Howl, Battle Cry, Battle Command in Battle Orders na 20; Enigma, Soul Drainer, Arachnid Mesh, Marrowwalk, Wildspeaker, dva Constricting Ring; day 1 dva Spirita, Lore, Stealth, caster craft rokavice in pas, brilliant prstana.
Razlika: Hiim nosi amulet Skull collar in na swapu Blade of Ali Baba; merc je Act 2 Defiance z The Reaper's Toll, Griffon's Eye in Innocence.

barbarian/warcry.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Barbarian Changes and Testing results
barbarian/warcry.author: JuxtAPoser
tips: Leveling: Throw ali Frenzy, na hardcore varnejši War Cry.
S14: Natural Resistance je omejena na 75 %; One-Handed Mastery dvigne DS cap s 35 na 45 % (crit je močnejši od DS); Two-Handed Mastery je malo oslabljena.

barbarian/whirlwind-2-h.title: PD2 S13 Barb Guide – Full Progression
barbarian/whirlwind-2-h.author: philanthropy777
barbarian/whirlwind-2-h.skills: Max Whirlwind, Two-Handed Weapon Mastery in Increased Speed, po 1 točka v ostale; max Battle Command, ostalo Battle Orders.
barbarian/whirlwind-2-h.stats: Dexterity do okoli 10.000 attack ratinga (skupaj s Concentration auro merca), 1.400–1.600 lifea, ostalo Strength.
barbarian/whirlwind-2-h.gear: Eth {{Bloodtree Stump}} (mastery skilli, resi, ED) do mirror crafted orožja; {{Halaberd's Reign}} s 3 socketi (ED/max jeweli), {{Highlord's Wrath}} (DS; korupcije FRW ali skill), {{Tyrael's Might}}, {{Soul Drainer}} z DS korupcijo (solo boljši od {{Steelrend}}, ki se splača le v P8), {{String of Ears}} (ali {{Verdungo's Hearty Cord}}, {{Siggard's Staunch}}), {{Gore Rider}} s FRW korupcijami, {{Wisp Projector}}; mastery in FRW grand charmi, torch, Annihilus; swap {{Ondal's Wisdom}} za Battle Orders.
barbarian/whirlwind-2-h.merc: Act 1 Vigor (FRW) z {{Mist}} (Concentration: več AR kot Faith in cenejši), {{Vampire Gaze}}, {{Templar's Might}}, {{Lava Gout}}, {{String of Ears}}, {{Marrowwalk}}, {{Bannerlord's Call}} (+1 korupcija dvigne level Vigorja).
tips: Soul Drainer je tvoj edini vir mana leecha.
S skoraj max DS, crushing blowom in leechem ubiješ skoraj vse v enem prehodu; boss pade v 4–5 sekundah.
FRW se splača do okoli 220 %, potem ima padajoč učinek.
S14 patch notes: Halaberd's Reign izgubi +2 masteries (dobi več Battle Cry in Battle Orders).
vs_hiim: Enako: Whirlwind, Two-Handed Weapon Mastery, Battle Command in Battle Orders na 20; Halaberd's Reign, Tyrael's Might, Highlord's Wrath, Gore Rider, Wisp Projector, Siggard's Staunch; merc z Mist, Vampire Gaze, Templar's Might, Lava Gout, Marrowwalk, String of Ears in Bannerlord's Call.
Razlika: Hiim nosi Steelrend namesto Soul Drainer, na swapu Call to Arms, in ima 11 točk v Iron Skin.

barbarian/whirlwind-2-h.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Barbarian Changes and Testing results
barbarian/whirlwind-2-h.author: JuxtAPoser
tips: Whirlwind je v S14 oslabljen (Two-Handed Mastery), a po avtorju malo: endgame ostaja S tier mapper.
Ves IK set še vedno mapa od prvega dne; tudi budget Bloodtree Stump z Lionheart in rare helmom potrebuje le 1–2 prehoda.
Dual wield bleed (dva Razor Edge) je nova budget možnost zaradi več crit škode.

barbarian/double-throw.title: Pd2 S12 Closed Beta Mini Guide/Showcase – Throw Barb
barbarian/double-throw.author: JuxtAPoser
barbarian/double-throw.skills: Po 1 točka v Iron Skin, Combat Reflexes, Increased Speed in Natural Resistance; max Battle Command s 3 predpogoji; max Double Throw in njegove sinergije; ostalo v Throwing Mastery (vsaj 30 % crit).
barbarian/double-throw.stats: Približno enako Vitality, Strength in Dexterity: 1.800–2.000 lifea (2.200 z BO), okoli 130 Strength, nič Energy.
barbarian/double-throw.gear: Dve močni metalni orožji (crafted 400–600 % ED, eno z Amplify Damage); budget {{Lacerator}}. {{Veil of Steel}}, {{Enigma}} (mobilnost, MF), {{String of Ears}}, {{Laying of Hands}} ali crafted IAS rokavice, {{Raven Frost}}, prstan z dvojnim leechem (4 % mana, 8 % life) ali BK/Wisp, {{War Traveler}} ali {{Gore Rider}}, {{Saracen's Chance}} (avtor ga ima raje od Highlord's). FHR breakpoint 27 ali 48.
barbarian/double-throw.merc: Act 5 Might z {{Beast}} (zadnji IAS breakpoint), {{Shaftstop}}, {{String of Ears}}, {{Dracul's Grasp}}, {{Marrowwalk}}; budget merc s {{Purity}}.
tips: Battle Command uporabi dvakrat. Frenzy napolni pred skupino, nato teleportiraj in mečeš.
Budget različica (Fortitude, Hustle, Lacerator) čisti T1 v 6–7 minutah; T3 Indo z dobro opremo v 5:30–6 minutah.
Preveri IAS breakpoint za svoje orožje, preden respecaš.
vs_hiim: Enako: Double Throw in Battle Command na 20; Lacerator (starter), Veil of Steel, Enigma, Gore Rider, Raven Frost; merc Act 5 Might z Dracul's Grasp in Marrowwalk.
Razlika: Hiim endgame maxa Frenzy in Double Swing ter nosi Wraith Flight, Steelrend, Arachnid Mesh in Highlord's Wrath; merc Blacktongue, Andariel's Visage in Innocence.

barbarian/double-throw.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Barbarian Changes and Testing results
barbarian/double-throw.author: JuxtAPoser
tips: Avtor priporoča leveling s Throwom ali Frenzyjem; s Throwom gre vse do Hella.
S14: Frenzy, Double Swing, Concentrate in Berserk zadevajo bolj zanesljivo; projektili Split Throwa sprožijo crushing blow.

druid/fire-elemental.title: PD2 S14 Druid Guide – Full Progression
druid/fire-elemental.author: philanthropy777
druid/fire-elemental.skills: Max Armageddon, Fire Claws (sinergija), Volcano in Molten Boulder, ostalo Fissure; po 1 točka v Solar Creeper in Oak Sage. Avtor je dodal še Hurricane, ki upočasni pošasti, ko z Gustom skočiš mednje.
druid/fire-elemental.stats: 210 Strength za {{Steel Carapace}} (brez −req jewelov), ostalo Vitality.
druid/fire-elemental.gear: {{Hellrack}} (crossbow: +skilli, −20 % fire pierce, 3–5 socketov s faceti, +1 korupcija) in {{Bannerlord's Call}} (+1 skill, 20 % FCR) – po avtorju boljše od Mang Song's različice; {{Ravenlore}} (BiS: +3 elemental, resi), {{Steel Carapace}}, blood craft amulet, {{Wisp Projector}} in {{Bul-Kathos' Wedding Band}} s FCR, {{Siggard's Staunch}}, {{Magefist}} (+1 fire), res škornji s half freeze (dva vira half freeze = CBF); 99 % FCR; elemental skillerji z lifeom in FHR (86), torch, Annihilus; swap {{Call to Arms}} in {{Lidless Wall}}.
tips: Po avtorju eden najhitrejših buildov v PD2 (top 5), a min-max različica je draga.
Igra: Gust in Volcano, ne čakaj, da pošasti umrejo; po plen se vrni le, ko filter kaj pokaže.
Najboljša mapa po avtorju je River of Blood.
vs_hiim: Enako: Armageddon, Fire Claws, Molten Boulder in Volcano na 20, Fissure kot ostanek; Hellrack, Bannerlord's Call, Ravenlore, Steel Carapace, Magefist, Siggard's Staunch, blood craft amulet, Wisp in BK, CTA in Lidless; merc Skyfall, Griffon's Eye, Innocence, Exile, Occultist, Marrowwalk.
Razlika: Hiimov drugi planer je S13 pot z Mang Song's Lesson in Imp Shank.

druid/fire-elemental.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Druid Changes and Testing results
druid/fire-elemental.author: JuxtAPoser
tips: Fissure je okrepljen, a po avtorju še vedno ni dober skill.
Fire Claws so predelani: več AoE, manj škode na posamezno tarčo.

druid/rabies.title: PD2 S14 Druid Guide – Full Progression
druid/rabies.author: philanthropy777
druid/rabies.skills: Max Rabies in sinergije Poison Creeper, Lycanthropy in Feral Rage; 1 točka v Fury (posamezne tarče), 1 v Solar Creeper in Carrion Vine, ostalo v Oak Sage. Dexterity do max blocka.
druid/rabies.gear: {{Grief}} (pierce, life in mana po kill; poceni) ali {{Plague Bearer}}; 3 poison faceti; nov S14 oklep {{Spectral Plate}} (+1 skill, phasing skozi pošasti, PDR) – po avtorju naredi Rabies enega top buildov sezone. Blood craft amulet, dva {{Bul-Kathos' Wedding Band}}, {{Verdungo's Hearty Cord}}, {{Titan's Grip}} s half freeze korupcijo (CBF), {{Waterwalk}}, {{Spirit Ward}} (block, +2 skilla), magic jeweli s +5 % poison skill damage (novo v S14), shape shifting skillerji ali poison large charmi.
druid/rabies.merc: Act 1 Vigor s {{Pus Spitter}} (sproži Lower Resist), {{Innocence}}, {{String of Ears}}, {{Anvilguard Strap}} (pierce), {{Marrowwalk}}.
tips: Pre-endgame za kravje mape (nizek poison res) in Bastion Keep; endgame z vsemi faceti dela T3 ear mape v manj kot 6 minutah.
Igra: Feral Rage za hitrost, Rabies se širi od pošasti do pošasti, ne čakaj. Na bossih Rabies in nato Fury vsakih okoli 4 sekunde.
Zelo vzdržljiv: max block in 2.700–2.800 lifea.
vs_hiim: Enako: Rabies, Poison Creeper, Lycanthropy in Feral Rage na 20, Oak Sage kot ostanek; Grief ali Plague Bearer, Spirit Ward, Spectral Plate, Titan's Grip, Verdungo's, Waterwalk, blood craft amulet, dva BK; merc s Pus Spitter, Innocence, String of Ears, Marrowwalk in Anvilguard Strap.
Razlika: Hiim endgame maxa še Carrion Vine in nosi Jalal's Mane; merc ima Vampire Gaze in Dracul's Grasp.

druid/rabies.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Druid Changes and Testing results
druid/rabies.author: JuxtAPoser
tips: Spectral Plate zamenja Bramble, ki je dajal škodo, a doda veliko udobja: tečeš skozi pošasti. Rabies je po avtorju A–S tier, če ti je všeč poison igra.

druid/pure-poison-creeper.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Druid Changes and Testing results
druid/pure-poison-creeper.author: JuxtAPoser
tips: Poison Creeper je eden boljših druidovih mapperjev: enoročen, ne rabiš gledati zaslona ne potionov, zelo varen in primeren za hardcore.
S14 popravek (strupi iz različnih virov se ne prepisujejo več) da creeperjem veliko več škode na posamezno tarčo: zdaj so uporabni tudi za map bosse in Ubers, česar v S13 niso zmogli.
Z Lower Resist od merca je škoda na bossih še večja.

necromancer/poison-nova.title: PD2 S14 Necro Guide – Full Progression
necromancer/poison-nova.author: philanthropy777
necromancer/poison-nova.skills: 1 Bone Armor; max Poison Nova in sinergiji Poison Strike ter Desecrate; max Golem Mastery (5 golemov), 1 Iron Golem iz polearma s {{Purity}} (Prayer aura), Blood Golemi (life na zadetek), Blood Warp, ostalo Bone Wall ali Blood Golem.
necromancer/poison-nova.gear: {{Skull Collector}} (6 socketov, nadgrajen; FCR, MF), {{Andariel's Visage}} (−10 % enemy poison res; po avtorju BiS), povsod poison faceti, blood craft amulet, {{Bul-Kathos' Wedding Band}} in {{Wisp Projector}} z LPK korupcijo ali {{Constricting Ring}}, {{Arachnid Mesh}} s FHR korupcijo, {{Trang-Oul's Claws}} (15 % poison skill damage, half freeze korupcija za CBF), škornji s trojnimi resi (lightning res je težava), poison skillerji s FHR, torch, Annihilus, swap {{Call to Arms}} in {{Lidless Wall}}.
necromancer/poison-nova.merc: Act 3 Static Field s {{Skyfall}}, {{Exile}}, {{Innocence}} in {{Flickering Flame}}.
tips: Vedno 125 % FCR (ne 75): ob teleportu Poison Nova zadene dvakrat, kar zagotovi one-shot.
Igra: teleport ali Blood Warp v skupino, sprosti Novo, pojdi naprej; vrni se le po plen, ki ga pokaže filter.
Za posamezne tarče in močne elite uporabi Desecrate. Blood Moon je nevaren (fizična škoda, velike skupine).
Po avtorju najhitrejši mapper v PD2; skupaj s Corpse Explosion med top 5.
vs_hiim: Enako: Poison Nova, Poison Strike, Desecrate in Golem Mastery na 20; Skull Collector, Andariel's Visage, Trang-Oul's Claws, Wisp Projector, BK ali Constricting Ring, blood craft amulet; merc Skyfall, Exile, Innocence, Flickering Flame.
Razlika: Hiim nosi Black Hades ali Cage of the Unsullied in Siggard's Staunch; eden od Hiim planerjev je Trang-Oul's različica z Death's Web.

necromancer/poison-nova.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Necro Changes and Testing results
necromancer/poison-nova.author: JuxtAPoser
tips: Poison Nova v S14 dobi več poison skill damage iz sinergij, od levela 28 naprej pa raste počasneje: zgodaj je boljša, endgame s +skilli malo slabša.
Large charmi s poison skill damage so boljši od skillerjev; na budgetu T1 mape zelo hitro.

necromancer/poison-strike.title: S13 PD2 Poison Strike Necromancer Mini Guide and Demo
necromancer/poison-strike.author: DarkHumility
necromancer/poison-strike.skills: Max Poison Strike in sinergiji Desecrate ter Bone Armor; max Golem Mastery (5 Blood Golemov: life na zadetek in tank), Blood Warp do 0 s cooldowna, 1 Revive, 1 Blood Golem.
necromancer/poison-strike.stats: Strength za opremo, čim manj Dexterity (necro ima slab block frame), veliko obrambe, okoli 10.000 attack ratinga, ostalo Energy.
necromancer/poison-strike.gear: {{Plague}} na elite Fanged Knife s +5 Poison Strike (Cleansing aura, Lower Resist ob udarcu) ali {{Blackbog's Sharp}}; {{Martyrdom}} (+5 Poison Strike) v drugi roki; {{Andariel's Visage}} (pierce, IAS), {{Innocence}} (Blade Shield proži Bone Armor), {{Trang-Oul's Claws}}, {{Highlord's Wrath}}, {{Carrion Wind}} (Poison Creeper še zniža poison res), {{Raven Frost}} (CBF), {{Arachnid Mesh}}, {{Waterwalk}}; Shael rune za FHR in hitrejši block.
necromancer/poison-strike.merc: Merc z {{Innocence}}, {{Ferocity}} (taunt), {{Exile}}, {{Beast}} (Fanaticism za IAS breakpoint), {{Occultist}} in {{Sandstorm Trek}}.
tips: Poison Strike sam zniža poison res za 50 %. FCR 48 je dovolj (Blood Warp), IAS mora doseči max frame.
Curse-ov ne rabiš; fortified mape so enako dobre kot navadne.
vs_hiim: Enako: Poison Strike, Desecrate, Bone Armor in Golem Mastery na 20, Blood Warp; Plague in Martyrdom, Andariel's Visage, Innocence, Trang-Oul's Claws, Arachnid Mesh; merc s Ferocity, Innocence in Exile.
Razlika: Hiim nosi Marrowwalk, blood craft amulet, SoJ in Wisp Projector; merc je Act 3 s Prayer (Iron Wolf).

necromancer/poison-strike.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Necro Changes and Testing results
necromancer/poison-strike.author: JuxtAPoser
tips: S14 popravek: pierce iz Poison Strika traja le toliko kot animacija (prej predolgo), kar je nerf.
Kljub temu ostaja S tier za T3 ear in fortified mape; na budgetu je manj prepričljiv.

necromancer/teeth-bonespear.title: PD2 S13 Necro Guide – Full Progression
necromancer/teeth-bonespear.author: philanthropy777
necromancer/teeth-bonespear.skills: Max Bone Spear in njegove sinergije Bone Armor, Teeth in Bone Spirit; 5 točk v Golem Mastery za 2 Blood Golema (delita ukradeni life s tabo), ostalo Blood Warp.
necromancer/teeth-bonespear.stats: Strength za opremo, ostalo Vitality (Energy še ne).
necromancer/teeth-bonespear.gear: {{White}} (Dol Io) na wandu z +Bone Spear ali +Bone Spirit (kupi bazo s +3), {{Lore}}, {{Stealth}} (75 % FCR), amulet +2 necro, {{Splendor}} na glavi s +2 Bone Spirit, caster craft rokavice in pas, dva brilliant prstana (dvakrat half freeze = CBF). S circletom +3 in boljšimi bazami okoli 6.000 škode.
necromancer/teeth-bonespear.merc: {{Insight}}, safety craft helm in oklep (PDR), blood crafti.
tips: Bone Spear v PD2 izstreli 3 kopja; magic škoda deluje v okoli 85 % corrupted zon.
Farmaj Chaos Sanctuary in corrupted zone; za Travincal avtor raje predlaga Clay Golem build.
vs_hiim: Enako: Bone Spear, Bone Spirit, Teeth in Bone Armor na 20, Blood Warp; White, Splendor, Lore, Stealth; merc Act 2 Defiance z Insight.
Razlika: Hiim nosi še Wormskull, Spirit Shroud, Trang-Oul's Claws, Gloom's Trap, Rite of Passage in Venomous amulet.

necromancer/teeth-bonespear.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Necro Changes and Testing results
necromancer/teeth-bonespear.author: JuxtAPoser
tips: S14: novi jeweli z magic skill damage in rare oprema s +skilli in FCR močno okrepijo Bone in Dark Pact builde, ki sta prej težko dosegla T3.

paladin/light-sacrifice.title: PD2 S13 – Paladin Guide – Full Progression
paladin/light-sacrifice.author: philanthropy777
paladin/light-sacrifice.skills: Max Holy Shock in sinergije Resist Lightning, Salvation ter Blessed Aim; 1 Holy Shield; Sacrifice do levela 18 (največji AoE radij); ostalo v Joust (skok s cooldownom 1,5 s, po skoku hitrejši tek).

Vsak Twister cast zmanjša cooldown Gusta za 0,5 s. Gust je omejen na 0,5 s, zadošča pa tudi 0,7 s.

V beti Deadly Strike deluje tudi s fizičnimi spelli (4× Lo v orožju = 80 % DS). Razvijalci so napovedali, da ga bodo pri nekaterih skillih, verjetno tudi pri Twisterju, izklopili. Hiimov planer »2H-Max DS« z {{Brimstone Rain}} je odvisen od tega.
Na bossih uporabljaj Tornado, ker je hitrejši za single target.
Okoli 2.100 lifea, max block in 24k obrambe: build je primeren tudi za hardcore.
vs_hiim: Enako: vsi štirje Hiimovi planerji so avtorjevi in se ujemajo z videom: Neophyte, Lore, Splendor, Stealth, Heaven's Brethren, Nightsmoke, Horizon's Tornado, Twilight's Reflection, Fenris, Soul Drainer, Siggard's Staunch, Wisp Projector, Constricting Ring, CTA in Lidless; merc Ascendant (Amplify Damage), v endgameu Iron Wolf s Skyfall in Griffon's Eye.

T3 mape gredo, ear mape so prepočasne in nerodne.

Iron Golem s {{Purity}} da Prayer auro (level 12) za močno regeneracijo; Infinity na golemu ni potreben.
Budget oprema (brez torcha) stane zelo malo; po avtorju sanjski zgodnji farmer.

assassin/dragon-tail-fire-kick.skills: Max Dragon Tail in Dragon Talon (sinergija; Dragon Talon je tudi močan single target in s fizično škodo ubija fire immune); Dragon Flight do cooldowna 1 s; 1 Blade Shield (leech); visoko Burst of Speed ali Fade; Shadow Master po želji kot tank.
assassin/dragon-tail-fire-kick.stats: Strength za opremo, nekaj Dexterity za attack rating, ostalo Vitality; vsaj 48 FHR.
assassin/dragon-tail-fire-kick.gear: Dragon Tail pretvori vso fizično škodo v ogenj, zato štejejo off-weapon ED, min/max škoda, crushing blow, deadly strike in −enemy fire res; ED na orožju ne šteje. Škoda brce pride iz škornjev, zato jih vedno nadgradi do konca. {{Astreon's Iron Ward}} (najboljši flat damage; alternativa {{Stalker's Cull}} ali {{The Redeemer}}) s fire faceti, {{Phoenix}} (BiS: Redemption za sustain, ED, −enemy fire res), {{Veil of Steel}} (ali {{Crown of Ages}}, {{Guardian Angel}}), {{Saracen's Chance}} ali amulet s +4/+5 martial arts, {{Steelrend}}, {{Siggard's Staunch}} (crushing blow, obramba) ali {{Nosferatu's Coil}}, nadgrajeni {{War Traveler}} ali {{Gore Rider}}, swap {{Call to Arms}} in {{Lidless Wall}}; assassin torch, martial arts GC-ji z lifeom in FHR.

Bug: napad se včasih ne registrira; takrat se z Dragon Flight umakni (Shadow Master pomaga).
Na zaslonu okoli 50k škode, s korupcijami do 60k; brez merca z −fire res je build opazno šibkejši.

amazon/summon-zon.gear: Igraš kot podpora svojim sencam (»summon necro« slog): {{Suicide Branch}} (FCR, +1 slam in socketi) za 90–99 FCR, {{Spirit Ward}}, {{Enigma}} (Valkyrie napadejo le, če teleportiraš na pošasti), {{Metalgrid}} (Iron Golem z {{Beast}} da Fanaticism; Beast lahko nosiš tudi sam), amulet in rokavice s +2 passive skills in FCR, {{Arachnid Mesh}}, {{Wisp Projector}} (Heart of Wolverine), škornji z resi in FRW, passive skillerji in {{Gheed's Fortune}}. amazon/summon-zon.merc: Act 3 Lightning s {{Skyfall}}, dvema {{Dream}} in {{Templar's Might}} (Might aura za sence); manjkajoči FCR nadomestita {{Gloom's Trap}} in {{Trang-Oul's Claws}} (skupaj 50–60 FCR).
tips: Avtor ga sam imenuje »meme« build: počasnejši, a udoben in varen; T1 in T2 mape gredo.
Ritem: Battle Orders, teleport v paket, nekaj Decoyev, nato Slow Movement, ki več kot prepolovi hitrost pošasti in projektilov.

sorceress/combustion.gear: Orb (BiS +6 in 30 FCR, fire skill dmg in 2 socketa; v videu {{Eschuta's Temper}}), {{Kira's Guardian}} s 3 fire faceti (resi, half freeze), {{Ormus' Robes}} s +Combustion (BiS: vsak Fire Ball ima 8 % možnosti za dodaten Combustion), {{Mara's Kaleidoscope}} (ali amulet s FCR), 2× {{Constricting Ring}} za 200 FCR, {{Phoenix}} (−28 % fire pierce; Redemption, zato ne rabiš MPK in LPK), brilliant škornji s half freeze (s Kira's CBF), torch, Annihilus, fire skillerji in FHR (60 ali 86), swap {{Call to Arms}}.

sorceress/combustion.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Sorc Changes and Testing results

sorceress/multishot-enchantress.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Sorc Changes and Testing results

sorceress/thunder-storm.title: Project Diablo 2 Season 14 – Sorc Changes and Testing results

paladin/sanctuary-sacrifice.stats: Strength za opremo, Dexterity do max blocka, ostalo Vitality.
